content.short: ONTO Wallet is a multichain Web3 wallet for managing identities, crypto assets, dapps, and blockchain access.
content.description: ONTO Wallet is a multichain Web3 wallet that puts blockchain access, digital identity, and asset management in one app. Users can hold and transfer crypto, connect to dapps, manage Web3 identity features, and use the wallet as a general entry point for supported networks including TON-related assets and services. Explore Hundreds of dApps and discover your favorite!. Native cross-chain bridge & multi-chain exchange. ONTO Wallet fills a practical wallet role because users need safe account access before using TON apps, payments, swaps, or collectibles.
